display.title: Episode 404: The Strange Gift (Parshas Chayei Sarah)
display.summary_short: Rivkah's kindness at the well in Parshas Chayei Sarah, a family Shema, and the story of Nachum Ish Gamzu, whose box of jewels turned to sand: 'this too is for good'.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Parshas Chayei Sarah 5750. Uncle Yossi explains that the Torah is a living Torah with lessons for every week. Eliezer, sent to find a wife for Yitzchak, asks Hashem for a sign: a girl who offers water not only to him but to all his camels. Rivkah does exactly that, showing her chesed. Like the Avos and Imahos, who watch us from Gan Eden, we should help friends with food and clothing and also help their neshamah by learning Torah and doing mitzvos together. After the Hakochainik march, a large family of children recites the Shema and one of the Twelve Pesukim, and everyone gives tzedakah to bring Moshiach sooner. Story time is a bedtime tale: Yehoshua tells his father how Hashem turned Avraham's dust into arrows, and his father tells of Nachum Ish Gamzu, whose gift of jewels for the king is stolen and replaced with sand. 'This too is for good,' he says, and with Eliyahu HaNavi's help the sand wins a war. Uncle Yossi then celebrates a listener's 100 on her Chumash test and explains, from Rashi on 'v'heyei brachah', that Avraham's children have the power to bless one another.
display.lesson: Be kind like Avraham, Sarah and Rivkah, help others in body and soul, and remember that whatever Hashem does is for the good.
